ns2:section.sectionText: Please note: in addition to the scheduled weekly seminar, this course requires attendance of the Unit for Criticism's Modern Critical Theory Lecture Series on Tuesdays, 5:15-6:45 p.m. CST. It is not yet confirmed whether the series will take place in person, online via Zoom, or in a hybrid format. Any updates will be shared here as soon as possible, and enrolled students will be contacted directly by the instructor as well.
